description: Search messages across all conversations (individual chats and groups), or within one specific contact chat or group.

group_id.description: Optional: limit search to a specific group. Accepts the group chat_id (e.g. 120363041234567890@g.us), the id from get_groups, or the group name.

phone.description: Optional: limit search to a specific contact's individual chat. Group messages are excluded from this scope — use group_id for groups.

query.description: Search query to find in message text

name: search_messages
